notes: Every value carries a src URL. 'verifiedBy' says how it was checked: 'page' = product/TDS page fetched and read; 'tds-pdf' = data-sheet PDF downloaded and text-extracted; 'search-listing' = value comes from the retailer's own listing title/snippet in web search (the page itself was blocked to automated fetch: homedepot.com, homedepot.ca, rona.ca, lowes.com all refused); 'secondary' = trade article, city handout or blog quoting the code/standard (official ICC/ANSI/NRC text was not fetchable).
Retail case data (sq ft, pieces, thickness) differs by SKU even within a nominal size. Treat these as typical examples, not defaults to hard-code without a user override.
Nominal vs actual: Floor & Decor lists actual sizes smaller than nominal (e.g. 24x24 = 23.5x23.5; 12x24 = 11.7x23.5; 24x48 = 23.7x47.4). Box sq ft is the retailer's per-piece coverage times pieces.
thkIn values are converted from the listed mm (1 in = 25.4 mm) and rounded to 3 decimals; thkMm is the listed value.
'UNVERIFIED' = looked for but could not confirm from a source.

standards.name: ANSI A108.5 (thinset mortar bond coverage)
standards.note: Average contact >= 80% interior dry; >= 95% exterior and shower/wet installations; verified by removing >= 3 tiles. TCNA Handbook: natural stone 95% everywhere, no void > 2 sq in, none within 2 in of corners.

standards.name: ANSI A108.02 lippage (sec 4.4)
standards.note: Ceramic/porcelain tile: joints 1/8 in (3 mm) to < 1/4 in (6 mm): 1/32 in (1 mm) + actual tile warpage; joints >= 1/4 in: 1/16 in (2 mm) + warpage; gauged porcelain panels/slabs, any joint: 1 mm, no warpage added. Some summaries put lower bound at 1/16 in joint: check current edition.

standards.name: ANSI A137.1 / ANSI A326.3
standards.note: Tile recommended for level interior spaces walked on when wet must have wet DCOF >= 0.42, measured per ANSI A326.3. Not a 'slip-proof' guarantee; IW+ class for standing water (Crossville usage).

standards.name: ANSI A118.10 (load-bearing bonded waterproof membranes for thin-set tile); A118.10-LV variant; A118.12 (crack isolation)
standards.note: Cited by RedGard, Hydro Ban, AquaDefense data sheets. Thickness/coverage come from each manufacturer, not the standard.

standards.name: IRC P2709 shower receptors (site-built pans)
standards.note: Liner/subbase slope 1/4 in per ft to weep holes; finished floor 1/4 to 1/2 unit vertical in 12 horizontal; liner extends >= 2 in beyond rough jambs and >= 2 in above finished threshold; no nails/perforations within 1 in of threshold top (per secondary quotes). Curb 2-9 in above drain is UPC/local; ADA threshold max 1/2 in.

standards.name: IPC 417 / UPC 408 (commercial / western states)
standards.note: UPC 408 (Sammamish WA handout): subpan slope not less than 1/4 in/ft nor more than 1/2 in/ft; threshold 2-9 in above drain; membrane >= 3 in above finished threshold; benches lined >= 3 in. IPC 417.5.2 exact wording: UNVERIFIED (ICC site blocked).

stairs.note: Riser and tread variation within a flight <= 3/8 in; nosing projection variation <= 3/8 in. Local amendments exist.

falls.shower: 1/4 in per ft minimum to drain (liner and finished floor); 1/2 in per ft maximum on finished floor (IRC P2709 as quoted; UPC 408 states same 1/4 to 1/2)
